exact_tokens: The current TierContext in orchestrator-subagent-integration.md is overloaded: mixes decomposition/view identity, workspace binding, project heuristics, live execution hints, and requested/effective runtime state
orchestrator-subagent-integration.md should stop owning a canonical mixed runtime object; it should consume canonical execution/runtime context by reference
TierContext replacement/wrapper is one of the most important structural follow-ups still open
ActiveAgent, crew structs, and coordination payloads are still tier-keyed and therefore inherit the same problem
notes: Coordination state is one of the places where stale tier_id usage will quietly persist unless explicitly migrated
